instruction:
You are a signalling design reviewer checking `SSC-02-LH-06`, a task-owned synthetic SSC-02 signal overlap, approach speed, and sighting photo package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values below for numeric grading. Signal sighting and overlap workflows shape the context only; this instance does not run signalling software, parse a real photo log, or validate an operator standard.

## Scene

- Design case: `CASE-SSC02-SIGHT-06`
- Signal arrangement: `SIG-02-ARRANGE-06`
- Approach speed table: `SPEED-02-APPROACH-06`
- Sighting photo log: `PHOTO-02-SIGHT-06`
- Route grade data: `GRADE-02-ROUTE-06`
- Sighting criterion: `CRIT-02-SIGHT-06`
- Sighting review response: `MEMO-02-SIGHT-06`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Approach speed | {{ approach_speed_kmh }} km/h |
| Reaction time | {{ reaction_time_s }} s |
| Braking rate | {{ braking_rate_m_s2 }} m/s^2 |
| Adverse grade | {{ grade_percent }} % |
| Available sighting distance | {{ available_sighting_distance_m }} m |
| Required sighting time | {{ required_sighting_time_s }} s |
| Provided overlap | {{ provided_overlap_m }} m |
| Distance to danger point | {{ danger_point_distance_m }} m |
| Photo chainage | {{ photo_chainage_m }} m |
| Signal chainage | {{ signal_chainage_m }} m |
| Maximum photo offset | {{ max_photo_offset_m }} m |
| Warning time | {{ warning_time_s }} s |

Checks:

- Approach speed in m/s equals approach speed divided by 3.6.
- Stopping distance uses the grade-adjusted braking deceleration.
- Sighting time equals available sighting distance divided by approach speed.
- Overlap margin equals provided overlap minus distance to danger point.
- Photo offset equals the absolute difference between photo chainage and signal chainage.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when sighting, stopping-distance, overlap, and photo-offset margins are non-negative; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Preserve the object IDs above, state the task-owned synthetic source-pack boundary, and explain whether the baseline source pack passes the docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, signal-plan validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "approach_speed_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "effective_braking_deceleration_m_s2": <numeric_value>,
  "stopping_distance_m": <numeric_value>,
  "sighting_time_s": <numeric_value>,
  "sighting_time_margin_s": <numeric_value>,
  "stopping_distance_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "overlap_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "photo_offset_m": <numeric_value>,
  "photo_offset_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "warning_distance_m": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

[meta]
name = "signal-overlap-approach-speed-sighting-photo-package"
description = "SSC-02 signal approach speed, sighting photo, stopping-distance, and overlap metrics"
long_description = "Calculates deterministic SSC-02 signal sighting metrics from a task-owned synthetic source pack. The template combines approach speed, grade-adjusted stopping distance, sighting time, stopping-distance margin, overlap margin, photo chainage offset, warning distance, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "signal-overlap-sighting"
standards = ["rail signal sighting workflow", "operator overlap review workflow"]
tags = ["electrical", "rail", "signal", "sighting", "overlap", "approach-speed", "photo", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.approach_speed_kmh]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "SPEED-02-APPROACH-06 approach speed"
min = 100.0
max = 100.0

[params.reaction_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "CRIT-02-SIGHT-06 reaction allowance"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.braking_rate_m_s2]
type = "float"
unit = "m/s^2"
description = "SPEED-02-APPROACH-06 braking rate"
min = 0.78
max = 0.78

[params.grade_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "GRADE-02-ROUTE-06 adverse route grade"
min = 0.5
max = 0.5

[params.available_sighting_distance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PHOTO-02-SIGHT-06 available sighting distance"
min = 720.0
max = 720.0

[params.required_sighting_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "CRIT-02-SIGHT-06 required sighting time"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.provided_overlap_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SIG-02-ARRANGE-06 provided overlap"
min = 300.0
max = 300.0

[params.danger_point_distance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SIG-02-ARRANGE-06 distance to danger point"
min = 220.0
max = 220.0

[params.photo_chainage_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PHOTO-02-SIGHT-06 sighting photo chainage"
min = 12540.0
max = 12540.0

[params.signal_chainage_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SIG-02-ARRANGE-06 signal chainage"
min = 12480.0
max = 12480.0

[params.max_photo_offset_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CRIT-02-SIGHT-06 maximum allowed photo offset"
min = 80.0
max = 80.0

[params.warning_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "CRIT-02-SIGHT-06 warning-time equivalent for distance ledger"
min = 35.0
max = 35.0

[outputs.approach_speed_m_s]
description = "Approach speed in metres per second"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.effective_braking_deceleration_m_s2]
description = "Braking rate after adverse grade allowance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.stopping_distance_m]
description = "Reaction plus stopping distance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.sighting_time_s]
description = "Available sighting time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.sighting_time_margin_s]
description = "Available sighting time minus required sighting time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.stopping_distance_margin_m]
description = "Available sighting distance minus stopping distance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overlap_margin_m]
description = "Provided overlap minus distance to danger point"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.photo_offset_m]
description = "Absolute offset between photo chainage and signal chainage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.photo_offset_margin_m]
description = "Maximum allowed photo offset minus actual photo offset"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.warning_distance_m]
description = "Approach speed times warning time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when sighting, stopping, overlap, and photo-offset margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
